summary: Iteration 17 testing completed for new quote status flow (Estados de Cotizaciones). All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend code review verified all test-ids and implementations are correct. Authentication with Google OAuth prevented direct UI testing via Playwright (token expiration), but code inspection confirmed correct implementation.

backend_invoice_endpoint.description: POST /api/quotes/{quote_id}/invoice accepts multipart/form-data with PDF file and optional invoice_number. Validates Aprobada status required. Returns invoice_pdf_url and invoice_number on success.

backend_collect_endpoint.description: POST /api/quotes/{quote_id}/collect marks as Pagada, validates Facturada status required. Notifies warehouse for equipment quotes (if warehouse_email configured).

backend_deliver_endpoint.description: POST /api/quotes/{quote_id}/deliver marks as Entregada (equipment only). Validates Pagada status and equipment category required.

backend_duplicate_endpoint.description: POST /api/quotes/{quote_id}/duplicate creates new version in Borrador with incremented version number and parent_quote_id reference.

backend_settings_endpoint.description: GET/PUT /api/config/settings supports admin_email, warehouse_email, and implementation_email fields.

frontend_settings_emails.description: Settings.jsx has 3 email fields with correct data-testids: admin-email-input, warehouse-email-input, implementation-email-input, and save-emails-button

frontend_action_menu.description: Quotes.jsx dropdown menu includes all new actions: Modificar (Nueva Versión), Facturar, Cobrar, Marcar como Entregada (equipment), Enviar a Implementación (implementation)

frontend_invoice_modal.description: Invoice modal has file upload for PDF and optional invoice number input with correct data-testids: invoice-number-input, invoice-file-input, invoice-submit-btn

frontend_status_colors.description: STATUS_COLORS includes all new states: Enviada (blue), Facturada (purple), Pagada (emerald), Entregada (teal), Enviada a Imple (amber)

backend_authentication.description: All new endpoints require authentication, returning 401 when no token provided

critical_code_review_comments: All new endpoints correctly implemented with proper state validation
Invoice endpoint saves PDF to uploads/ directory with unique filename pattern: invoice_{quote_id}_{timestamp}.pdf
Duplicate endpoint correctly resets timestamps and creates new quote_number with version tracking
Settings endpoint correctly stores and retrieves all 3 email configurations
Frontend action menu conditionally shows 'Marcar como Entregada' for equipment or 'Enviar a Implementación' for implementation quotes
Status transitions follow correct flow: Borrador -> Enviada -> Aprobada -> Facturada -> Pagada -> (Entregada|Enviada a Imple)

test_credentials.note: Token may have expired - requires fresh Google OAuth login for UI testing

seed_data_creation: None - used existing quotes for testing. Duplicate test created new quote version.
